name: To Train A Killer: First Hunt
source:
You wake up in a strange place, and see two strange individuals before you: a hyperactive, manic young man, and a stoic, quiet gentleman.  It quickly becomes evident that you have been brought here for a special purpose:

To be the young man's first kill.

[From [url=https://norbez.itch.io/to-train-a-killer-first-hunt]itch.io[/url]]
